verdict.rationale: Slack's official Web API covers posting with chat.postMessage, which sends a message to a channel. The official MCP server lets agents retrieve, read and send messages, and the official OpenAPI spec covers bot and user token usage of Web API methods, so the core agent read/post path is clearly documented. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of OAuth scope granularity (e.g. per-scope read/write permissions), a documented Web API method for reading channel history, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
